rationale: Lessey 2002 carries the induction experiment this edge needs and the bibliography already holds it. Full text inspected 2026-11-18: RNase protection on PRIMARY isolated human endometrial epithelium shows increasing doses of recombinant HB-EGF inducing the beta3 integrin subunit, with a parallel dose series in Ishikawa cells and immunofluorescence for the intact alphavbeta3 protein in that line. The paper is already attached to LE015 by CIT-006 for the reciprocal regulation step, but no register topic lists it for LE018, so the generator could not emit it. Attached per edge rather than by editing LIT-HBEGF-001, which would also fan it onto LE016 and LE068. Support is PARTIAL, not direct: case-insensitive whole-word counts over the full text give beta5 0 and avb5 0, so two of the three entities of the composite target E_ITGAVB3_5 (ITGAV, ITGB3, ITGB5) are never measured and heterodimer assembly is shown only qualitatively in a carcinoma line.

Rawlings 2021 is the first publication on this edge, whose only prior seed is the in-house SOFIA observation. Full text inspected 2026-11-18: primary human endometrial assembloids decidualized with 8-bromo-cAMP and MPA for 4 days secrete decidual prolactin, measured by ELISA in spent medium over a timecourse (Figure 1C-D, with Figure 1 source data 1). Support is PARTIAL and cannot be otherwise: S_DECIDUALIZED is a derived state with no entity in config/node_entity_map.tsv, so the combined MPA/cAMP stimulus is the decidualization protocol itself rather than a perturbation of the Boolean source node, and the validator refuses edge_support='direct' for such a source. PRL and IGFBP1 are not interchangeable reporters of one state; this attaches PRL evidence only.
